description: Claude's AskUserQuestion: its questions with their options to pick, an Other choice to type your own answer, and Answer / Skip, inside the call's card (or its own amber box). Answered, the card folds back to one line saying what was picked.
opens: An AskUserQuestion call's permission request (always asked)

parts.name: where
parts.shows: At the bottom of the AskUserQuestion card (amber border, its input NOT opened, since the form says it all), or, with no card, in an amber-bordered box whose first line is "Claude has a question" in bold.

parts.name: question
parts.shows: Questions one under another, 10px apart. Each: its header dimmed (60%) then two spaces then the question in bold, on one wrapping line.

parts.name: options
parts.shows: Under the question, 4px apart: one radio button per option (check boxes if the question allows several), its label, and under the label its description dimmed, both wrapping.

parts.name: Other
parts.shows: A last choice "Other" in the same group. Picked, a text field appears under it (placeholder "Your own answer") and takes the focus.

actions.does: Same as Answer, when Answer is enabled.

parts.name: buttons
parts.shows: A row under all the questions: "Answer" (accent; greyed until every question has an answer) and "Skip".

actions.does: Sends each question's answer (its picked labels comma-joined, plus your own text) back to Claude. The form goes; the card's summary becomes "<header>: <answer> · <header>: <answer>" and its Input view lists each question, its options and "  →  <answer>"; Claude's acknowledgement is its Output.
Declines all of them: Claude is told "The user chose not to answer. Carry on without their answers, or ask in your reply." The form goes.

states.name: asking
states.shows: The form in the amber-bordered card; the chat is waiting on you (sidebar dot yellow, desktop notification "Claude has a question for you").

states.name: answered
states.shows: One line: "AskUserQuestion  Header: answer · Header: answer" with Input / Output buttons, normal border.

states.name: skipped
states.shows: The card ends as the tool reports it; no "denied" is added (it's "not answered"). With no card, a note "not answered AskUserQuestion".
